data.assumption: “अगस्त” से मतलब अगस्त 2026 है, और “अधिकृत की पर कभी कैप्चर नहीं की” से मतलब ऐसे non-test payment attempts हैं जिनका status 'authorized' है और जिनके लिए कोई settlement item नहीं है; राशि हर currency की minor units में अलग-अलग दी गई है.
data.sql:
SELECT payment_attempts.currency, SUM(payment_attempts.amount_minor) AS value
FROM payment_attempts
JOIN orders ON orders.order_id = payment_attempts.order_id
WHERE orders.is_test = FALSE
  AND payment_attempts.is_test = FALSE
  AND payment_attempts.business_date >= DATE '2026-08-01'
  AND payment_attempts.business_date < DATE '2026-09-01'
  AND payment_attempts.status = 'authorized'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM settlement_items
    WHERE settlement_items.attempt_id = payment_attempts.attempt_id
  )
GROUP BY payment_attempts.currency
